subject.summary: Evidence-attestation skill can emit a privacy-safe proof object for a registry/verifier claim.

claims.text: The evidence pattern is represented as a named skill rather than only a taxonomy proposal.
A local checker can validate the attestation shape without reading private logs.
The skill instructs agents not to copy raw prompts, transcripts, source, secrets, or customer data into the attestation.
A registry has accepted this as a curated capability.

omissions: No raw SKILL.md body is copied into evidence refs; reviewers can inspect the referenced file if authorized.
No private session transcript, prompt, secret, source file, or customer data is included.
No registry acceptance is claimed before a curator/verifier acts.
limits: This proves the attestation structure is inspectable, not that every future attestation is truthful.
The checker validates shape and privacy booleans; it cannot independently verify each referenced artifact's semantics.
Registry scoring or star assignment remains external to Pluribus.
stale_if: skills/evidence-attestation/SKILL.md changes without updating the fixture/checker
the Gaia issue feedback changes or rejects the named-skill direction
the attestation schema changes without versioning receipt_type
the checker stops being included in package files
